question: What ritual acts should be performed with these Nityās in diagrams described later?
premises: These Nityās are to be used in worship.
Other diagrams will be described in a later section.
Worship and related acts apply to those diagrams as well.
inference: One should perform worship and related acts with these Nityās in the diagrams to be described later.
plain_english: With these Nityās, one should also perform worship and so forth in the diagrams that will be described in the section on diagrams.
